lines: Badla na apne aap ko, jo the wahin rahe
couplets.en: We did not change, we stayed as we were.

lines: Milte rahe sabhi se, magar ajnabi rahe
couplets.en: We met everyone, yet remained strangers.

lines: Duniya na jeet pao to haaro na khud ko tum
couplets.en: If you cannot win the world, do not lose yourself.

lines: Thodi-bahut to zehan mein narazgi rahe

lines: Hum jiske bhi qareeb rahe, door hi rahe
